name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast for all interactive elements, with a fallback to 3px at 4.5:1 contrast when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active. This ensures keyboard users always see a clear, high-contrast indicator without sacrificing usability for those who need reduced motion. The trade-off is a slightly larger ring for some users, but it’s necessary to meet WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility while respecting individual preferences.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG 2.2 requires 3:1 for focus indicators in high-contrast mode. Alternative: Use 3px at 7:1 always, then switch to 4px at 3:1 when reduced motion is active. Settle with browser testing in both modes.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast always, then switch to 4px at 3:1 when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active. This meets WCAG 2.2 in both normal and high-contrast modes while keeping the ring visible for keyboard users who need reduced motion. Trade-off: the 4px ring in reduced-motion mode is slightly less visible, but it prevents the failure case where both modes combine to break compliance.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 3:1 in reduced-motion mode fails WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 minimum for focus indicators in high-contrast mode. Better: Use 3px at 7:1 always, then switch to 3px at 4.5:1 when `prefers-contrast: high` is active. Settle with browser testing in both modes.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast always, switch to 3px at 4.5:1 when `prefers-contrast: high` is active. Result: WCAG-compliant focus indicators in all modes. Owner: accessibility-w1.
